name: Yoon
source:
A spirited, easy-going WolfHalve rescued in the 4th district, Yoon serves as a squad commander in the Halve resistance.

He has a strong sense of duty and is usually the last to leave the most dangerous front lines. But his easy-going nature is a bit problematic when it comes to how many sexual encounters he gets into...

Likes: Talking to people, sexual encounters, food

Dislikes: Loneliness, giving up

[From the [url=https://arashi.eccentric-studio.org/en/characters/yoon]official description[/url]]
